personalKnowledge.storePath.description: Machine-local absolute path for the knowledge store directory. Prefer a normal local folder rather than OneDrive, Dropbox, Google Drive, or iCloud Drive; cloud-drive clients can cause file locks and permission races. This pointer is excluded from VS Code Settings Sync; use GitHub Sync for cross-machine content synchronization and version history.

personalKnowledge.environmentsPath.description: Machine-local location where the 'Migrate' action moves Python environments. Defaults to ~/pkm-envs if left empty.

personalKnowledge.mcpPythonPath.description: Absolute Python 3.10+ executable used to create and run the managed PKM MCP environment. Machine-specific; not synced to remote hosts.

personalKnowledge.mcpRuntimePath.description: Machine-local path for the managed PKM MCP virtual environment. Defaults to <Environments Root>/pkm-mcp.

personalKnowledge.mcpServerPath.description: Machine-local directory for generated PKM MCP server code. Defaults to <Knowledge Root>/mcp-server.

personalKnowledge.openOnStartup.description: Automatically open the Personal Knowledge Manager panel on VS Code startup.

personalKnowledge.agentSessionArchiveKee.description: Number of newest completed Agent Sessions to keep in Archived. Older completed Sessions are automatically moved to Agent Session Trash, where they remain recoverable until explicitly deleted.

personalKnowledge.mcpEnabledFeatureDomai.description: Agent-visible PKM MCP feature domains. Disabling a domain removes its tools from discovery and rejects direct calls. The Personal Knowledge Manager UI remains available.

personalKnowledge.skillRouterEnabledSolu.description: Enabled mature Skill Router solutions. Copilot default is always restored as the required automatic fallback when PKM retrieval is disabled or unavailable.

personalKnowledge.skillRouterSourcePrior.description: Ordered Router Skill sources. Configure this from the Router dashboard so active Subscriber IDs remain valid.

enumDescriptions: Follow the VS Code display language.

personalKnowledge.logLevel.description: Logging verbosity. Use 'debug' to record all activity (including page views and messages) to the Output panel and log file; 'info' logs user actions only.

personalKnowledge.loadProfilingEnabled.description: Record privacy-safe first-open and view-loading timings to the PKM Load Profiling output and JSONL log. Disabled by default. Enable only while diagnosing slow Knowledge, Tools, or Settings loading.

enumDescriptions: Use GitHub Copilot via the built-in VS Code Language Model API (no API key needed).
Use Azure OpenAI. Set aiEndpoint, aiModel (deployment name), aiAzureApiVersion, and run 'Personal Knowledge Manager: Set AI API Key'.
Use any OpenAI-compatible endpoint (OpenAI, vLLM, Ollama, etc.). Set aiEndpoint, aiModel, and run 'Personal Knowledge Manager: Set AI API Key'.
personalKnowledge.aiBackend.description: Which AI backend to use for script summarization.

personalKnowledge.aiModel.description: Model name (openai-compatible) or deployment name (azure-openai). Ignored for Copilot.

personalKnowledge.aiEndpoint.description: Base URL for azure-openai (e.g. https://myres.openai.azure.com) or openai-compatible (e.g. https://api.openai.com/v1). Ignored for Copilot.

personalKnowledge.aiAzureApiVersion.description: Azure OpenAI API version (azure-openai backend only).

personalKnowledge.chatHubUrl.description: Chatroom: WebSocket URL of the hub to connect to (e.g. ws://host:7345). Leave empty if you host the hub yourself.

personalKnowledge.chatRoom.description: Chatroom: default room name to join.

personalKnowledge.chatDisplayName.description: Chatroom: display name shown to other members. Defaults to your OS username.

personalKnowledge.chatSharedSecret.deprecationMessage: Legacy only. Join each Room through the Chatroom UI; Room credentials are stored in VS Code SecretStorage.
personalKnowledge.chatSharedSecret.description: Legacy machine-local Chatroom shared secret. New Room credentials use VS Code SecretStorage.

personalKnowledge.chatHubPort.description: Chatroom: stable per-user TCP port for the self-hosted Hub. PKM assigns and persists a user-specific port when unset.

personalKnowledge.chatInviteHost.deprecationMessage: Use Personal Knowledge Manager: External Link Host. Existing values remain supported as a migration fallback.
personalKnowledge.chatInviteHost.description: Machine-local hostname or network-interface address advertised in Chatroom Magic Links. The Hub still listens on all interfaces.

personalKnowledge.externalLinkHost.description: Machine-local hostname or network-interface address used by public content links, Chatroom invites, Subscription links, and Server Stable Links. Defaults to this machine's hostname.

personalKnowledge.contentGatewayPort.description: Stable per-user port for public Note, Skill, Paper, and Script links. PKM assigns and persists a user-specific port when unset. Private content returns 404.

personalKnowledge.chatHistoryLimitMB.description: Chatroom: how much chat history (in MB) the hub archives to disk per room, so messages survive rejoining, closing a room, or restarting the hub. The oldest messages are dropped once the limit is reached. Set to 0 to disable archiving.

personalKnowledge.serversProxyPort.description: Stable per-user loopback port for managed-server URLs under /s/<slug>/. PKM assigns and persists a user-specific port when unset.
